field_name: Base/subfarm/cultivar-to-area binding
identifiability_target: S1 identity, production system, cultivar family
minimum_observation_design: verified mapping and productive-area authority

field_name: Plant density, tree age, productive shoots/canes and flower-bud census
minimum_observation_design: same-scope census with denominator and sampling method

field_name: DECIDUOUS_NATURAL / DECIDUOUS_FORCING / EVERGREEN assignment
minimum_observation_design: business-confirmed system assignment per subfarm-season

field_name: Executed pruning date/type/intensity/scope
identifiability_target: fruiting wood, bud potential, leaf/source and future shoots
minimum_observation_design: event log; intensity unit and scope required

field_name: Greenhouse close/open and heating start/stop with intensity
minimum_observation_design: timestamped executed event log

field_name: Greenhouse air temperature at hourly resolution
minimum_observation_design: calibrated sensor, time zone and gap/quality flags

field_name: Dormancy/budbreak observation date and method
minimum_observation_design: standardized cultivar-scoped observation protocol

field_name: 10%, 50%, 90% bloom dates with denominator/method
identifiability_target: bloom progress and bloom cohort origin
minimum_observation_design: repeatable sample frame and observed dates

field_name: Effective flowers and fruit-set sample with denominator
minimum_observation_design: matched flowers-to-set-fruit sample by cultivar/scope

field_name: Tagged bloom cohort with repeated fruit stage/count/weight through color break and ripe
identifiability_target: fruit growth, maturity distribution and cohort lineage
minimum_observation_design: repeated cohort sampling; distinguish ripe from harvested

field_name: Daily actual harvest quantity and operational exclusions
minimum_observation_design: authoritative source/date/quantity ledger; not a ripe-state substitute

field_name: Leaf area/retention, canopy health and radiation proxy
minimum_observation_design: repeat at key growth stages; method-specific units

field_name: Fruit number/load sample and fruit-thinning event
minimum_observation_design: repeat by stage with explicit plant/subfarm denominator

field_name: Root-zone temperature and substrate moisture/EC when available
minimum_observation_design: sensor or repeat manual observations with unit/quality

field_name: Pollination window, pollinator introduction and seed-index sample
minimum_observation_design: event log plus sampled cohort; seed count optional

field_name: Marketable fraction/grade and berry size by cohort
minimum_observation_design: independent size and grade sample

field_name: Carbohydrate reserve assay or validated proxy
minimum_observation_design: assay method and tissue/date protocol

field_name: Leaf gas exchange / source capacity experiments
minimum_observation_design: controlled study; not a routine sensor mandate

field_name: High-frequency cohort tracking and detailed stage imaging
minimum_observation_design: research sub-sample only

field_name: Root growth/biomass sampling
minimum_observation_design: targeted destructive or validated proxy study
